## Summary
Design for Stage 1 (workspace foundation): toolchain manifest and Ansible layout (`builder` full, `lab` placeholder), `workspace/restore.sh` per ADR-001 section 4a, `scripts/quality-gate.sh`, `scripts/pr-contract` (PC-1 to PC-7, with untrusted-input handling), and the CI skeleton including an `ubuntu-24.04-arm` job. Drafts ADR-005 (toolchain) as Proposed. Design only: no scripts, roles, or workflows.

## Change request
CR: #2

## Class
3. It fixes the toolchain manifest format, the restore path for the ephemeral workspace, and the CI and `pr-contract` enforcement that every later stage depends on.

## Files
- `docs/cr/CR-2/` (README, impact-analysis, design, acceptance-criteria, implementation-plan)
- `docs/adr/ADR-005-toolchain.md` (Proposed)
- `docs/README.md` (index entries)

## Review focus
All thirteen open questions raised in the first version were resolved by the approver; decisions are recorded in `docs/cr/CR-2/design.md` section 9 and reflected in the design and ADR-005. Notable outcomes: apt uses a minimum version (documented exception to the pin rule), TOML manifest, Podman deferred, `scripts/pr-body` added because `gh pr create --template` needs a terminal, PC-5 stays strict for `docs/adr/`.

The decisions were pushed after the PR was marked ready, so any earlier approval no longer covers the latest push. Merging this PR accepts ADR-005 as written.
